mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sms_messages (id, tenant_id, phone, text, code_enc, purpose, encoding, segments, status, error, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{phone}, #{text}, #{codeEnc}, #{purpose}, #{encoding}, #{segments}, #{status}, #{error}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id AS tenant_id, t.slug, t.display_name, count(*) AS messages FROM sms_messages m JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.status = 'SENT' AND m.created_at >= #{from} AND m.created_at < #{to} GROUP BY t.id, t.slug, t.display_name ORDER BY messages DESC, t.slug

SELECT m.id, m.created_at, t.id AS tenant_id, t.slug, t.display_name, m.phone, m.text, m.status, m.error FROM sms_messages m JOIN tenants t ON t.id = m.tenant_id
ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
